##### Project general facts

Mövenpick Residences Dubai Motor City Phase 1 is a branded residential project developed by CITYVIEW Developments in partnership with Accor, marking the first Mövenpick-branded residence in the area.The collection includes 307 residences across studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, designed with a wellness-led "Bio-ROI" philosophy that emphasises longevity, daily quality of life and sustained performance alongside conventional investment value.

Residents enjoy three dedicated amenities floors — the first floor, the 21st floor, and the rooftop. The offering spans an indoor and outdoor gym powered by Technogym, a rooftop infinity pool, a family pool and a kids' pool, a basketball half court, a padel court, a jogging track, an outdoor cinema, an outdoor and indoor kids' play area, a co-working zone, a lounge area and beverage bar, a multi-purpose area, a sky garden meditation area, a Mediterranean-themed garden, a Japanese Zen garden, a yoga area, a pet area, and steam and sauna facilities for recovery.

Interiors feature 3.3-metre bedroom and living ceilings, kitchens with 2.7-metre ceilings and a 6.6-metre lobby, floor-to-ceiling windows with high-performance acoustic glazing, smart locks, and porcelain wood-look tile throughout. Kitchens include a full suite of integrated appliances with natural oak and matt laminate cabinetry and quartz countertops with terrazzo finish. Bathrooms feature quartz vanities with terrazzo effect, travertine-look porcelain on shower walls, walk-in showers with floor-to-ceiling glazing, and chrome fixtures. Studios are delivered fully furnished, while one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments are semi-furnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Motor City in Dubai is a unique and lively community that combines the essence of urban living with a captivating theme centered around the world of motorsports and automobiles. Nestled in the heart of Dubai, this community is an embodiment of modernity, innovation, and passion for all things automotive.

The streets of Motor City are adorned with a distinct charm, echoing the revving of engines and the excitement of racing. As you wander through this neighborhood, you'll notice the architectural design and layout that pays homage to the theme, with road names reminiscent of famous race tracks and automotive legends. It's a place where enthusiasts and families alike come together, united by their shared love for everything related to cars and motorsports.

Motor City's commitment to green spaces and landscaping is evident in its beautifully manicured parks and lush gardens. These serene areas provide a welcome escape from the exhilarating atmosphere of the community, offering a peaceful retreat for residents to unwind, exercise, or simply enjoy the outdoors.
